description: This Java class 'ImportService' handles importing books in Goodreads format into the application. It processes GoodreadsBookImport objects, converts them into Book entities, and saves them using BookService. It also manages associating books with predefined or user-created shelves and handles rating scaling.

classes.name: ImportService
classes.description: Service class responsible for importing Goodreads-formatted books, converting them into internal Book entities, and saving them while associating with shelves and ratings.

methods.name: importGoodreadsBooks
methods.description: Main method to import a collection of GoodreadsBookImport objects, saving valid books and returning the list of saved books.

methods.name: toBooks
methods.description: Converts a collection of GoodreadsBookImport objects into a list of Book entities.

methods.name: toBook
methods.description: Converts a single GoodreadsBookImport into an Optional<Book>, handling validation and associations.

methods.name: toAuthor
methods.description: Creates an Author object from a name string if not blank.

methods.name: toPredefinedShelf
methods.description: Determines the predefined shelf for a book based on shelves string, read date, and shelf name mapping function.

methods.name: toCustomShelf
methods.description: Creates or finds a user-created shelf based on shelves string and shelf name mapping.

methods.name: toRatingScale
methods.description: Converts a rating value to a scaled RatingScale object.
